script.diag.missingDirective: missing // af-prelude-version: {want}; the runtime refuses chunks without it
script.diag.duplicateDirective: the prelude version may be declared exactly once
script.diag.versionMismatch: the chunk declares prelude version {got}, but this runtime provides {want}
script.diag.returnFromLoop: returning from loop() exits the loop; use session.exit() to end the session
script.diag.unknownFieldSuggest: unknown field {field} on {parent}; did you mean {suggestion}?
script.diag.afOp: af.op is an engine internal; use session.*, llm.* and the other public namespaces
script.diag.maintenanceOnly: {path} is limited to system and scheduler turns
script.diag.capabilityMissing: {path} requires capability {capability}, which this agent does not enable
script.diag.topLevelYield: {path} yields, so it cannot run at chunk top level; call it inside loop()
script.diag.localLoop: loop must be a top-level function; the engine calls top-level function loop(), not a nested one
script.diag.missingLoop: the chunk must define function loop(); the engine has nothing to start without it
script.unavailable.require: require is not available in the Goja sandbox; use // af-import: <pkg> or global prelude APIs
script.unavailable.process: process is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox; use os.env() for allow-listed variables
script.unavailable.fs: fs is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox; use files.* for storage
script.unavailable.fetch: fetch is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox; use http.request() or http.get()
script.unavailable.timers: setTimeout/setInterval are not available; use time.sleep() or scheduler.*
script.unavailable.eval: eval is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
script.unavailable.functionConstructor: dynamic Function() construction is not available in the AgentFlow sandbox
script.doc.capabilityTip: The agent must enable this capability to make the call
script.doc.maintenance: maintenance provenance only (system or scheduler turns)
script.doc.streamNote: Iterate with `for (const delta of llm.stream(...))`; breaking early closes the stream automatically.
script.doc.yieldsTip: Parks the session: call it inside loop(), not at chunk top level
script.status.errorsAndWarnings: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} · {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}
script.api.session: The current session: inbox, replies, pushes and durable state.
script.api.session.inbox: Wait for the next inbound message. This parks the session.
script.api.session.send: Reply to the active inbound message. Needs an active message: timer, cron and boot turns have none.
script.api.session.reply: Finish the turn with a structured assistant message; an llm.forward() result can be passed as it is.
script.api.session.send_delta: One fragment of a streamed answer. Held until end of turn when the safety profile has filters.
script.api.session.push: Send proactively to a channel. reply_to may be null.
script.api.session.push_user: Deliver a proactive message to a user channel resolved by identity.
script.api.session.exit: End the session permanently. The loop never resumes.
script.api.session.state: Durable per-session key/value store (64 KiB values, 256 keys).
script.api.session.state.set: Store a JSON-encodable value for this session.
script.api.session.state.get: Read a stored value; undefined/null when the key was never set.
script.api.session.state.delete: Remove a key from the session store.
script.api.session.state.list: Every stored key and value for this session.
script.api.log: Structured logging at the session level.
script.api.time.sleep: Park the session for a duration; it is idle, not busy-waiting.
script.api.agent.info: The running agent identity and effective settings, including per-user overrides and memory store locality.
script.api.agent.config: The deployment profile as data. Secrets appear as { env } or { cred } markers.
script.api.agent.send: Deliver a message to agent:<name> or session:<id>. Subject to can_contact.
script.api.agent.request: Send and wait for a reply; timeout is in seconds.
script.api.agent.list: Visible sessions scoped to the agent contacts.
script.api.agent.spawn: Start a child session from a spawn profile.
script.api.scheduler: Session-scoped timers delivered as timer messages.
script.api.scheduler.cron: Cron subset: */N minutes or fixed minute/hour; rest *.
script.api.scheduler.cancel: Cancel a timer. Timers survive hot reload, so cancel before re-registering.
script.api.llm: Model calls: chat, streaming, embeddings and reranking.
script.api.llm.chat: One model call. opts: model, temperature, max_tokens, thinking, tools, tool_choice.
script.api.llm.stream: Token stream iterable. Use `for (const delta of llm.stream(...))`; early break closes automatically.
script.api.llm.forward: Forward the current OpenAI-channel request on the metered path. Pass the result to session.reply().
script.api.llm.embed: Embed a string, an array of strings, or multimodal parts.
script.api.llm.rerank: Rerank documents; result indexes are zero-based.
script.api.openai: The request behind the current OpenAI-compatible turn (read-only).
script.api.openai.request: Full inbound request as JSON data (refused above 4 MiB; use llm.forward instead).
script.api.memory: Personal memory records scoped by the turn identity.
script.api.memory.write: Write a memory record into the agent memory profile.
script.api.memory.recall: Recall memories. Returns an array of matching records.
script.api.store: Raw scoped stores for custom schemas and tables.
script.api.store.put: Write a record. opts: ttl seconds, vector embedding.
script.api.store.scopes: Enumerate scopes. Maintenance provenance only (system or scheduler turns).
script.api.tools.list: Tool specs visible to this agent after skills and policy.
script.api.tools.run: Run a tool. needs_confirm tools suspend for confirmation and re-run with confirmed=true.
script.api.tool.def: Declare a model-visible tool at chunk top level before loop().
script.api.api: Configured external APIs (Goja TypeScript modules and Wasm/wazero modules). Call api.list(), api.call(), api.batch(), or api.<pkg>.<action>(args).
script.api.api.list: List configured external API packages and their actions.
script.api.api.call: Invoke an external API action by package and action name.
script.api.api.batch: Run multiple external API calls concurrently from Go and return ordered results.
script.api.shell: Shell commands: sandbox project jobs and SSH connections.
script.api.shell.run: Run one sandbox command on a project. opts: project, environment, workdir, env, timeout.
script.api.shell.start: Queue a sandbox job in the background; result arrives as a "shell.result" inbox message.
script.api.shell.status: Background job state and output tail.
script.api.shell.cancel: Stop a running background job of this session.
script.api.shell.spawn: Open an SSH connection or sandbox handle. Prefer shell.run for sandbox commands.
script.api.shell.exec: Run a command on a shell handle.
script.api.shell.write: Write a text file onto a shell handle.
script.api.http: Outbound HTTP with a private-address guard.
script.api.http.request: Execute an HTTP request (supports auth_service credentials resolved in Go).
script.api.os: UTC clock and allow-listed environment access.
script.api.os.env: Read an engine environment variable; "" when unset.
script.api.os.date: UTC date components or formatted timestamp.
script.api.mail: IMAP and SMTP; credentials resolve in Go, never in script.
script.api.mail.imap_fetch: Fetch mailbox messages. opts: host, port, user, mailbox, unseen, limit, auth.
script.api.mail.smtp_send: Send email. opts: host, port, user, from, to, subject, text_body, auth.
script.api.files: User-scoped project files with engine-native commits and refs.
script.api.files.put: Write a file scoped by the turn identity.
script.api.files.commit: Snapshot project files; opts: ref, message.
script.api.files.checkout: Restore a ref or commit id.
script.api.files.scratch: Scratch files shared with HTTP save_to and media handles.
script.api.user: Read-only facts about the user served by the turn.
script.api.user.usage: Token and quota usage for the user.
script.api.user.has_credential: Whether a stored credential exists; never returns its secret value.
script.api.user.get: Read one profile. Maintenance provenance only.
script.api.runtime.triggers: Merged trigger list snapshotted at boot.
script.api.credential.get: Resolve an allow-listed credential (every access is audited).
script.api.json.decode: Decode JSON; throws on malformed input.
script.api.af: Engine internals. Loop code should use public namespaces instead.
script.api.af.op: Internal bridge call. Prefer session.*, llm.* and public namespaces.
script.api.af.version: The prelude API version (2) the chunk runs against.
script.api.token_budget: Trim a prompt to the history budget (token_budget support chunk).
script.api.memory_routing_table: Rewrite a memory record before storage (used by memory.write).
script.api.memory_recall_handler: Recall hook for recency memory (used by memory.recall).
script.api.memory_semantic_recall_handle: Recall hook for semantic memory (used by memory.recall).
